value.title: Blueprint 001: Pij Emergent Communities (PEC)
value.summary: How the PEC directory is built: governance-branch ddocs written only by pij, a rebuildable store index, role addressing in delivery, and prompts for the prime.

sections.name: overview
sections.value: Pij Emergent Communities (PEC) rest on a per-project community directory that the prime and humans reshape as the work changes. Its definitions, memory and outputs are ddocs on the governance branch, written by one daemon-side writer through the ddocs CLI. The store holds pointers and live state (assignments, lineage, requests), and can be rebuilt from the branch. Delivery learns one new address form, `role:<id>`, and one new request field, the reply mode. Product docs (PRDs, blueprints, roadmaps) live on main under docs/project and are joined by ddocs links.

value.name: Project docs schemas
value.responsibility: The three schemas behind docs/project, joined by typed link cells.

value.name: Role schema
value.responsibility: The `pij/role` schema for role definitions, plus `pij/output` and `pij/memory` for outputs and memory notes.

value.name: Community layout
value.responsibility: `roles/<id>/role.dd.json`, `roles/<id>/memory/` (one note per file and a generated `INDEX.md`), `roles/<id>/outputs/<yyyy-mm>/`, `ROUTES.md`, `external.dd.json`. Rulings stay outside it.

value.name: Governance writer
value.responsibility: Writes a ddoc, runs `ddocs validate` and `ddocs build` by absolute path, and commits only the paths it wrote in the standing governance worktree with `git add` then `git commit --only` (ruling C8), refusing when those paths carry edits it did not make; no plumbing moves the branch under a checkout. Keeps copies of the `pij/*` schemas on the governance branch (ruling C9) and records the pointer. One writer per project, serialised by the daemon; a batch mode for imports. Named refusals for missing governance or ddocs.

value.name: Directory index
value.responsibility: Tables for roles (pointer and summary), assignments and lineage (seat, session, machine, from, to), requests (reply mode, requester) and outputs (pointer, subject, result). Rebuildable from the governance branch.

value.name: Role addressing and queue
value.responsibility: Resolves `role:<id>` and `role:<id>/<instance>` to exactly one live holder. With none, queues the request on the role and wakes the PA (else the prime) with runnable next steps; with several, refuses with the list. Stores the reply mode on the request.

value.name: Output notification
value.responsibility: Routes an output's notice to the requester with its reply mode, or to the nearest seat above as an FYI; block and failed always wake.

value.name: Memory prompt
value.responsibility: Before a compact or close of a role holder, delivers the memory prompt and holds the control until that turn ends.

value.name: Routing table
value.responsibility: Builds the table from role scopes, writes ROUTES.md, and delivers it on assign, after compact, on revive and on demand; sends changed rows as FYIs.

value.name: Directory view and prompts
value.responsibility: The prime's view: holders, waiting requests, latest outputs, memory freshness, and next-action prompts with runnable commands.

value.name: Role templates
value.responsibility: Versioned templates: core (prime, pm, pa, coder, reviewer), recommended (security), optional (devcontainer, researcher, note-taker, topic expert, docs-keeper, infra, release, test and QA, designer, transcriber).

value.name: Number claims
value.responsibility: `pij claim <kind>` hands out the next NNN per project and kind, and releases it on merge or close.

value.name: Delivery at merge
value.responsibility: On a PR merge, reads the PR's links to requirement rows and steps, records the delivery and fills `delivered_by` through a docs PR, and updates the owning PM's card.

value.name: Time-limit check-ins
value.responsibility: Stores a limit on each request; in the existing watchdog round, sends one check-in when the limit passes without an output or card update, and tells the PA (else the prime) when it goes unanswered.

value.name: Community skill route
value.responsibility: `/pij community`: teaches the prime, PM and PA their duties, and ships the doc procedures and examples; workers are told what to do by their packets.

value.decision: Memory is kept forever, one note per file, with a generated index.
value.why: Memory is the community's knowledge and storage is cheap; small files and an index let a seat read only what it needs and never conflict.

value.decision: One standard docs layout by type, every file NNN.
value.why: Blueprints are shared across many PRDs, so they cannot live in one PRD's folder; one layout everywhere is easier for agents than a per-project setting.

value.decision: Directory files on the governance branch; product docs on main.
value.why: Running the fleet is governance; what the product needs ships with its code, so a builder flips a requirement in the PR that delivers it.

value.decision: Use the ddocs CLI from pij-rs; no Rust port.
value.why: ddocs is TypeScript only. Writes are rare, so two launches per write are cheap. flowspace3's Rust parser is read-only and stays an option.
Shared files conflict under parallel writers; one file each never does.

value.decision: pij never starts a seat on its own.
value.why: Starting a seat costs money and context; the refusal names the command instead.
An extra wake costs a turn; a missed one strands an idle requester.

value.what: Directory write or output: ddocs validate, ddocs build, git add and commit.
value.rate: per request; about 5 launches, by absolute path
value.scaling: with requests, not with seats or time

value.what: Routes FYI after a scope change.
value.scaling: one message per live seat in the project; no launches

value.rate: inside the existing 60 s watchdog round
value.scaling: one store read per open request with a limit; no launches

value.what: Memory prompt before compact or close.
value.rate: per compact or close of a role holder

value.change: Review fixes and Jordan's rulings: queue, memory notes and index, safe verdicts, own-worktree writer, claims and delivery at merge, standard layout.
Plan 191: c-doc-schemas shipped; c-skill in-progress (doc procedures shipped, the /pij community route is s10).

Plan 190: c-role-schema, c-layout and c-writer shipped; c-writer's responsibility reworded per rulings C8 (commit only its own paths with `git commit --only`, no plumbing) and C9 (schema copies on the governance branch).
Plan 195: c-store (assignments, migration 0032), c-verbs (assign, release, external add, rebuild, the view, help) and c-orient (the directory view) in-progress; later steps add the rest.
Renamed forward per ruling C26: title, summary and overview name Pij Emergent Communities (PEC). Slugs and ids unchanged.
c-templates in-progress: the core and security templates ship in plan 194, compiled into the daemon; the optional templates come in s10.
Plan 196: c-claims and c-merge-delivery shipped. Delivery is the verb the merger runs (C23); the edits are printed for the PM's docs PR, never applied.
